messages:
rachel (People Ops): Heads-up: Marco L. will drop off a Surface tabletop display (flat-packed box) tomorrow 8:45am for a 9:30 demo. Courier notes "DO NOT STACK". Need a dolly + non-slip mat, a quick badge, and a low stool. Can someone help?

liam: I can meet the courier at 8:30 and bring the flat dolly from locker 6. Will mark box "FLAT - DO NOT STACK". :package:

tiara: I'll print a badge. Should it read "Guest: Marco L. - Demo" or "Visitor - Marco (Marketing)"? Also FYI the sticker printer is acting up so might go handwritten.

mailroom: If box has any plexi, tag FRAGILE. Otherwise Locker D5 fits flat items. Add delivery to https://redwood-internal/deliveries and note the "no stacking" instruction.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-registered: Marco L.  ID uploaded, vehicle HJK-404, courier ETA 8:40. Loading bay reserved 8:30-9:00.

facilities: Dolly + anti-slip mat will be at lobby by 8:15. We'll also bring strap set. Please don't let it sit upright in the corridor.

visitor: Marco L.: Thanks! I'll aim for 8:35. Box dims ~48x30x4, aluminum parts, no glass. Happy to sign if needed.

liam: Quick seating poll for the 9:30 demo: 1) window bench 2) high-top 3) conference nook. Reply with 1/2/3.

rachel (People Ops): Also note accessibility: Marco requested step-free access. Lock D5 reserved and labeled "Marco - Demo". Tiara  if printer is jammed, handwritten badge + laminate is fine.

tiara: Printer jam cleared (label roll), badge printed and laminated. :wrench:

liam: Poll result: window bench wins 4-1. Reserved and placed a small rug under the box for extra protection.

rachel (People Ops): Perfect  thank you all. Reminder: log delivery condition in the sheet and ping me if courier leaves unsigned. :raised_hands:
